top_signals.title: Bailey Says UK Is Seeing Subdued Second-Round Inflation Effects
top_signals.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey says the UK is not yet experiencing significant second-round inflation effects, citing a softening labor market. He speaks to Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz at the Federal Reserve's annual gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Yen Weakens Past 160 Per Dollar, Eroding Intervention Gains
top_signals.summary: The yen weakened past the key 160-per-dollar level as it extends a slide that’s erased more than half of its intervention-fueled gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
